henry hickson
LuminateOngoing

A long-term project with the aim of transforming spaces to create new experiences. One aspect is building light installations and providing event lighting. The Lumistick is a 1m light tube, six of which connect to a central control box, all packable into a single bag.

Space Pride2024

A fashion-tech collaboration with Space Pride, worn by bionic popstar Tilly Lockey. I designed the electronics and LED system, driving a live rainbow of swarm emergence (Conway's Game of Life) across the garment. Exhibited at the International Astronautical Congress in Milan and screened at Bristol Pride.

Press release
The Swarm Forest2025

An audio-visual art installation inspired by swarm robotics, designed and built with the CA:VE team. Using lights and sound we invite the audience to participate as a 'human swarm', collectively creating an emergent art piece and composing a piece of music together.

Paper: The Forest (2024)
The Emergent Forest2022

An earlier iteration of The Forest focusing on emergence and how an individual's interactions impact the collective. By setting a series of goals for each participant, the audience work together to swarm around the installation and witness the emergent sound and lightscape as they interact.

Rainbows in the Night2021

A long-exposure photography project from the depths of lockdown, when the streets were empty and morale was low. We used custom-programmed light tubes to bring some colour back to the streets.

Hover2021

A lockdown project about the supernatural. No AI was used in the making of this piece; instead a clever use of a tube light and some photo editing (by my talented partner!) gives this alien-like scene.

Spacechanger2020

An early Luminate project designed to change the feel of a space by lighting it in a unique way. One of a series of images taken in urban, often uninviting spaces, with an attempt to add some beauty and mystery to the scene.
